name: Infertility Treatment
overview: Scripture reveals God's blessing of fruitfulness as a fundamental aspect of His covenant relationship with His people, promising multiplication and the removal of barrenness (Genesis 1:28; Leviticus 26:9; Deuteronomy 7:14). The Lord’s desire is to transform barrenness into joyful motherhood, reflecting His sovereign power and gracious provision (Psalms 113:9). While God’s plans for His people are rooted in peace and hope (Jeremiah 29:11), believers are reminded of the seriousness of their commitments before Him (Matthew 5:26), underscoring the need for faithfulness and trust in His timing and purposes.
